listings.title: Insurance Claim Estimator (Korea)
listings.listing_description: Turn a Korean hospital receipt into an insurance payout estimate. Your agent reads policy certificates and receipts; the open-source insurance-claim-mcp server (MIT, runs locally via uvx) does the math with a fail-closed rule engine, so unverified riders return NOT_EVALUATED instead of a guess. Covers 실손 generations and common fixed-benefit riders, KCD code matching, and insurer document checklists. Estimates only, not a payout decision.

listings.title: US Supplemental Insurance Claim Estimator
listings.listing_description: Find out what your hospital indemnity, accident or critical illness plan should pay. Your agent reads the plan's schedule of benefits and the hospital bill's ICD-10-CM codes; the open-source insurance-claim-mcp server (MIT, runs locally via uvx) calculates each benefit with a fail-closed rule engine: admission, daily and ICU confinement, critical illness lump sums, accident fracture schedules and ER benefits. Anything the schedule doesn't confirm comes back NOT_EVALUATED, never a guess. Estimates only, not a claim decision.
